title: ContextProfile
description: Envelope schema for a context profile (an 'agent') — the YAML in contexts/*.yaml and the payload of POST /api/contexts. A profile applies four layers to a turn: a tool allowlist, an appended system_prompt, a pre_load_query injected under LIVE SELF-STATE, and an optional model override. `additionalProperties` is permissive: profiles carry many optional fields and new ones are added over time.

name.description: Unique profile key; also the agent name for run_agent/delegate.

tools.description: Allowlist of tool names the profile may call. Each must name a registered tool (enforced against the registry, not this schema).

system_prompt.description: Appended after the base system prompt.

pre_load_query.description: Read-only Cypher (rejected if it contains a write token) or a keyword; output injected under LIVE SELF-STATE.

model_preference.description: Overrides the chat model for this profile's turns. Honored on /chat; a sub-agent run CLAMPS it to the unmetered band. Blank/unresolvable keeps the default.

provider_hint.description: Provider for model_preference. Inert without model_preference (the resolver is only reached via it).

spawnable.description: Whether run_agent/delegate may spawn this profile as a sub-agent.

data_class.description: private (default when absent) keeps this profile's turns on no_log providers; public also admits free tiers that may train on prompts. A sub-agent run uses the stricter of this and its caller's class.

specialty.description: Free-text specialty used by select_agent token-overlap matching.

auto_assign.description: Goal keywords that auto-select this profile.
